Particularly associated with the art of the Rococo, but popularized again by the Impressionists, this medium became the specialty of Maurice-Quentin de la Tour after it was introduced to France by Rosalba Carriera. He was a German Catholic preacher of the Dominican order, born in Pirna, Saxony, and educated at the University of Leipzig.
